subject: Interest in the Embedded Systems & Firmware Engineering Intern Role at OrthoIQ
body:
I am Justin Mascarenhas. I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I wanted to reach out about the Embedded Systems & Firmware Engineering Intern role at OrthoIQ. Building sensing and feedback tools that surgeons can rely on in the operating room is the kind of hardware work I want to be part of, and I think my background fits what that intern role needs.

My work so far has been building firmware and hardware for small robotic and embedded systems from the ground up. I wrote bare metal firmware for a microcontroller platform that ran sensing and control in real time, and I built a tracking system that combined motor control, sensor input, and real time coordination into one working device. I also fabricated and wired my own circuit boards for earlier robotics projects.

I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss the role further, if your time allows. I can share my resume if that would be helpful.
hook_used: CEO framing, mission focused interest in OrthoIQ surgical sensing product, no register level technical detail per CEO calibration
